As the description continues, fluency breaks down: there are fragmented phrases, false starts, and fused tokens (‘CATCRIED A HOXSACROSS,’ ‘MUCHINDISIOUSPA’). Self-correction is present (‘BUT I DIDN'TENSON THAT I SAID…’), and propositional content becomes sparse with repetition and vague reference to dishes, making the later portion difficult to interpret. Nevertheless, the core gist of the picture is maintained.
